dct_title_s: Die neüwen Inseln, so hinder Hispanien gegen Orient bey dem land India ligen
dct_alternative_sm: Die neüwen Inseln, so hinder Hispanien gegen Orient bey dem land India ligen
dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Appears in the author's Cosmographei. Basel, Switzerland. 1550.; Illustrated with a large ship in the Pacific Ocean (""Mare Pacificum""), a Spanish flag in the Caribbean sea, and a Portuguese banner off the coast of present-day Brazil.; Illustrations of trees throughout the Western Hemisphere lands, and ""Canibali"" (cannibals) in present-day Brazil.; This is the eighth of thirteen known states of the map. The first state of the map appeared in 1540 in Münster's edition of Ptolemy's Geographia in an added section of updated maps. Münster then included it in his Cosmographia, starting in 1544. -From dealer's description.; Two sheets with vertical join at center.; Slight discolorations at both top corners; some toning throughout.
